plugin.name: OmaConnect
plugin.description: Seamless KDE Connect integration for Omarchy: Tailscale discovery, pairing, SMS, battery stats, clipboard sync, file sharing, remote commands, and media controls.

plugin.name: Advanced Audio Control
plugin.description: Advanced PipeWire and WirePlumber audio mixer for Omarchy: devices, multi-output groups, Bluetooth codecs, safety policies, microphone privacy, audio scenes, persistent routing rules, graph and service diagnostics, channel tests, support reports, and guarded recovery

plugin.name: Advanced Bluetooth Audio
plugin.description: Adds Bluetooth device details, reliable controls, codec selection, and per-device connect-time audio policies

plugin.name: Bluetooth codec
plugin.description: Shift Bluetooth audio fidelity: pick the A2DP codec or headset profile for each connected Bluetooth audio device.

plugin.name: Bluetooth Audio Modes
plugin.description: Switch Bluetooth music and microphone modes, choose headset codecs, and scan only when requested.

plugin.name: Device Battery Stats
plugin.description: Battery and charging status for Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless devices.

plugin.name: Peripheral Battery Indicator
plugin.description: Battery levels for wireless mouse, keyboard, headset & controllers in the bar, with a click-through popup and low-battery notifications.

plugin.name: Nothing Audio
plugin.description: Nothing earbuds and headphones in the Omarchy bar: battery, noise control, codec selection, and low-latency mode.

plugin.name: Power + Battery Health
plugin.description: The Omarchy power widget with battery charge protection.

plugin.name: Argus
plugin.description: CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network, battery, power, and temperature stats in the bar, with a full system panel: 2m/1h/24h history that survives restarts (the flight recorder), per-metric opt-in alerts with context snapshots, a filterable sortable process table, per-process GPU usage, drive SMART health, an alert hook for automation, and a GAME tab that configures your MangoHud in-game overlay live.

plugin.name: Pomodoro
plugin.description: Pomodoro focus timer with work/break phases, progress, and desktop notifications

plugin.name: Notification Center
plugin.description: Every notification you were sent, kept, and readable again

plugin.name: Omarchy Slack
plugin.description: Slack as a fast, themed Omarchy app: sign in with your browser, read and reply to DMs and channels, toggle presence and Do Not Disturb — with a mention badge in your bar. No Chromium, no half-gigabyte client.

plugin.name: GitHub Status
plugin.description: Not a notification inbox -- a status-bar dashboard for a solo maintainer's own repos: repository status, own open PRs with CI/review state, review requests, alongside notifications. Powered entirely by your authenticated gh CLI.

plugin.name: OmaKDEConnect
plugin.description: KDE Connect beyond the LAN with Tailscale peer discovery, stable-address pairing, clipboard sharing, and file transfer in the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Clipboard Manager
plugin.description: A native Omarchy bar panel for browsing and reusing clipboard history.

plugin.name: Downloads
plugin.description: aria2 download queue in the Omarchy bar: live speed, active and waiting transfers, pause/resume, and quick-add from the clipboard. Optionally starts the daemon on demand and lets it stop again once the queue drains.

plugin.name: Text Polish
plugin.description: Correct and refine clipboard text with Omarchy's default agent

plugin.name: Clipboard Button
plugin.description: Open Omarchy's built-in clipboard history from a theme-aware bar button.

plugin.name: MyIP
plugin.description: Your public IP at a glance: shows the live public IPv4 with its country flag in the Omarchy bar, with a calm offline state and a details panel with location, ISP/AS, address history and copy. Quietly warns once when your public IP changes (VPN-leak alert). Quiet, configurable polling (default 60 s), no key, no account.

plugin.name: My Network
plugin.description: Scans the local subnet and identifies every device on it: name, vendor, model and role inferred from mDNS, MAC vendor and open ports, plus a Tailscale peer list. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.network-scan

plugin.name: Omawire
plugin.description: Tunnel status, transactional switching, import, rename, QR export, live traffic and drop notifications in the Omarchy bar. Unofficial third-party widget for WireGuard tunnels; not affiliated with the WireGuard project.

plugin.name: Agent Orchestrator
plugin.description: Live monitor and workspace orchestrator for AI coding agents (Herdr, OMP, Hermes, Claude, Codex, Grok) in the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Session Browser
plugin.description: Browse previous sessions from every AI coding agent on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Copilot, Pi, Gemini, Grok) and resume any of them in a terminal.

plugin.name: Agent Usage
plugin.description: Weekly Claude and Codex usage, reset countdowns, and prorated pace in the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: FileBlade Agent Memory
plugin.description: Browse the instructions, rules, and durable auto-memory that coding agents load, and link a file to more agents, in the FileBlade blades.

plugin.name: Hyphae Memory
plugin.description: A local memory panel using a dedicated, restricted Hyphae service connection.

plugin.name: Runway
plugin.description: Checking-account cash forecast for the Omarchy desktop.

plugin.name: OmaFinSight
plugin.description: OmaFinSight — your FinSight balance forecast as a native Omarchy bar widget + desktop app: expected balance today, month-end and year-end across your accounts, per-account list, low-balance warnings, privacy-eye quick hide, and a full native charts app window. Reads from your self-hosted FinSight instance.

plugin.name: Shader Wallpaper
plugin.description: Animated, theme-colored and music-reactive GLSL wallpaper: aurora, thunderstorm, embers, nebula, ink and live weather, built around an icon of your choice. Replaces the stock background.

plugin.name: Omasticky
plugin.description: Markdown sticky notes pinned to the desktop.

plugin.name: Omascratch
plugin.description: A quick-note scratchpad that docks to a screen corner. Toggle with a keybind or the bar icon; font size, corner, and the keybind itself are all configurable from an in-panel settings view. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.weedwhitesandwine.omascratch

plugin.name: Scratchpad Deck
plugin.description: A visual scratchpad switcher for the Omarchy bar. Shows live previews of the windows hiding in your scratchpads and gives each one its own hotkey.

plugin.name: Hyprpin
plugin.description: Keeps chosen windows visible when you switch away from their workspace: moved onto a display of their own, parked in a corner, or tucked into the scratchpad. Compositor-level picture-in-picture for video calls.

plugin.name: Barber
plugin.description: Edit the Omarchy bar right on the bar: take widgets off, add them, move them and set them up where they are, with undo. Save layouts, and let the bar change them by itself when you dock, run on battery, go fullscreen or switch apps.

plugin.name: Garmin
plugin.description: Your Garmin day in the bar: a configurable metric chip (Body Battery, steps, sleep, or readiness) and a panel of customizable cards — day curve, sleep, steps, readiness, HRV, and more.

plugin.name: Omaltbar
plugin.description: Notch-shaped replacement for the Omarchy bar: it hosts your bar widgets and routes their clicks into Dynamic Island views for media, notifications, volume, brightness, weather, screen recording, and quick settings

plugin.name: Eglo Light
plugin.description: Unofficial plugin to control Eglo Connect / AwoX Bluetooth-mesh lamps from the bar: power, brightness, white warmth and colours. No app, no cloud, no hub.

plugin.name: omakeylight
plugin.description: Turns your monitor into a key light for video calls. Paints a warm-white layer above the wallpaper but below every window, so browsers and terminals stay usable on top of it. Adjustable colour temperature, brightness, and screen coverage, plus a directional falloff that fades the light across the screen to shape your face the way a real light source does.

plugin.name: Omarchy X-Ray
plugin.description: Trace any window, process, service, container, port, file, or device to the process behind it, how it started, and what it is using.

plugin.name: Services Manager
plugin.description: Manage and toggle background system services (Docker, PostgreSQL, UFW) on demand from the Omarchy status bar.

plugin.name: Exposé
plugin.description: macOS-style Exposé for Omarchy: one key or a hot corner shows every open window as a live preview. Type to search, press Space to Quick Look, press Enter to launch.

plugin.name: Omaspaces
plugin.description: Configurable Hyprland workspace indicators with per-app window icons, adjustable layout, and an in-widget editor for your own icon rules.

plugin.name: Boomux
plugin.description: Open a sliding Boomux Workspace, Agent, and Node pane from the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Workspace Thumbs
plugin.description: Bar workspace switcher: screenshot thumbs with number badges, optional app icons, and a hover preview.

plugin.name: Quakattro
plugin.description: A raycaster for Omarchy Quattro. The walls are tiled with your window manager's dwindle layout, the enemies are merchants of complexity, and the holy grail is Linux on the desktop.

plugin.name: Tour
plugin.description: Interactive desktop tour for Omarchy. Learn and understand the keyboard, keybindings, shortcuts, tiling windows, workspaces, menu, and bar. Optional window playground to practice tiling with demo windows. Getting-started tutorial and onboarding guide for beginners. Start it by clicking the button "Tour" in the bar.

plugin.name: Auto Wallpaper
plugin.description: Preview the active theme's wallpapers and automatically cycle or shuffle them on a schedule.

plugin.name: Wallpaper Explorer
plugin.description: Browse and apply wallpapers from any installed Omarchy theme without changing theme colors.

plugin.name: Wallpaper Engine
plugin.description: Use Steam Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as live Omarchy wallpapers. Adds menu > Style > Wallpaper Engine, which opens the thumbnail picker.

plugin.name: Themed Tray
plugin.description: Recolors every system tray icon to match the active Omarchy theme, including apps (like Steam) that ship a fixed-color icon instead of a proper freedesktop "-symbolic" one.

plugin.name: Game Mode Switcher
plugin.description: One-click Game Mode for Omarchy: lock compositor shortcuts, optimize Hyprland, silence the desktop, and optionally launch Steam in Gamescope / Big Picture.

plugin.name: Garden
plugin.description: A private year of coding on this Omarchy machine. Squares are half-hours in folders you watch — not GitHub.com, not token usage.

plugin.name: Ollama Cloud Usage (API)
plugin.description: Adds Ollama Cloud to the stock AI toolbar widget using your personal Ollama API key — no browser session needed.

plugin.name: OmaVibes
plugin.description: Cozy typing sound effects with over 40+ sounds, gamified typing stats with ranks, detailed analytics, random playback, and volume control for the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Screen Sharing Indicator
plugin.description: Pulsing red dot in the bar when the screen is being shared via PipeWire (Zoom, Teams, Discord, browser tabs, etc.).

plugin.name: Audio Resolver
plugin.description: Prepare camera footage for DaVinci Resolve on Linux by converting AAC audio to PCM in Resolve-ready .mov files without re-encoding video.

plugin.name: OmaPodman
plugin.description: Podman in the Omarchy bar: containers, images, volumes and networks on four tabs. Live CPU and memory, start/stop/restart, logs and a shell without a terminal, and one keystroke to reclaim whatever nothing is using.

plugin.name: Analytics
plugin.description: CPU and RAM analytics widget for the Omarchy bar

plugin.name: Omavoice
plugin.description: A virtual microphone for Zoom, Meet, and OBS. Meeting / Podcast / Clean, Voice looks, and an RNNoise or DeepFilterNet picker.

plugin.name: Mic FX
plugin.description: Noise suppression, gate, tone EQ, compressor and limiter for your microphone, in every app

plugin.name: Multi-output
plugin.description: Play the same audio on two or more outputs at once, such as two AirPods.

plugin.name: Internet Hotspot
plugin.description: Share your Ethernet internet over Wi-Fi with one click. Editable SSID/password and a live connected-devices list.

plugin.name: NetNeighbors
plugin.description: Fing-style Wi-Fi radar for the bar: one click shows every device on your network — vendor, hostname, MAC — and flags new ones that appear.

plugin.name: Omajabra
plugin.description: Jabra battery, connection, and audio controls in the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Áudio
plugin.description: Controle de volume, saída e mixer por aplicativo

plugin.name: Minha rede
plugin.description: Lista Wi-Fi e estado da conexão

plugin.name: Surfshark
plugin.description: Surfshark VPN in the Omarchy bar: on/off, fastest, nearest, same country, a pinned US exit, a random country, recents and a search across every location. Drives the official client's own daemon, so the app and the bar never disagree.

plugin.name: Aegis
plugin.description: AdGuard VPN in the Omarchy bar: one-click locations on a dot-matrix world map, with a live arc to your exit city.

plugin.name: Omalogimouse
plugin.description: Omalogimouse: battery, DPI, MagSpeed, acceleration, and button actions for Logitech MX Master mice on the Omarchy bar.

plugin.name: Capture
plugin.description: Clipboard-aware quick capture into an Obsidian vault — one analysis-ready note per capture, with YAML frontmatter and a reused tag vocabulary

plugin.name: Capture Board
plugin.description: One-click region screenshots with secondary capture and clipboard tools.

plugin.name: Immich Background
plugin.description: Rotates the desktop background through photos from your Immich server: albums, favourites, loose photos and shared links, narrowed by people, tags, rating, date or orientation. Crossfade, slide, wipe or zoom between them, one photo per screen if you like, with an optional photo-details overlay, a laptop-friendly power profile and an offline cache.

plugin.name: Spotlight
plugin.description: Unified Spotlight search for apps, windows, files, actions, clipboard, natural-language tools and the web

plugin.name: Phone
plugin.description: KDE Connect phone status: battery, pairing, and file share.

plugin.name: Omarchy Lacquer
plugin.description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks: themes, wallpapers, theme shuffle and aether generation; fonts, GTK, icons, cursor and nightlight; windows, animations and curves; shell style, bar and menu look; lock, boot and screensaver; terminals, btop and prompt; and every plugin's settings. Live, through the tools that already own each setting.
